dialogue.speaker: zawadi
dialogue.text: Everything so far has been inference. Drilling is the first time you hold the target.

dialogue.speaker: zawadi
dialogue.text: Three tools, cheapest first. Aircore and RAB punch shallow holes fast. Reverse circulation goes deeper, returns clean chips, and is the production workhorse.

dialogue.speaker: zawadi
dialogue.text: Diamond core returns an intact cylinder of rock. Expensive, slower, and the only method that shows you structure — so you can measure the vein instead of guessing it.

dialogue.speaker: zawadi
dialogue.text: Core is logged: lithology, alteration, veining, sulphides, structure, and recovery — because a metre you did not recover is a metre you know nothing about.

dialogue.speaker: zawadi
dialogue.text: Then sampling. Mark intervals on geological boundaries, not round numbers. Gold goes to fire assay on fifty grams, because it is spread so unevenly that a small sample is a lottery ticket.

dialogue.speaker: zawadi
dialogue.text: And QA/QC, which is not paperwork. Blanks catch contamination. Standards catch a laboratory drifting. A resource built on unchecked assays is not a resource.

dialogue.speaker: zawadi
dialogue.text: Results come back as intercepts. Twelve metres at four point three grams a tonne, from eighty-five metres.

dialogue.speaker: zawadi
dialogue.text: One caution. That is downhole length. If the hole cuts the vein at a shallow angle the true width is much less — and quoting downhole as thickness is the oldest flattering mistake in the business.

dialogue.speaker: zawadi
dialogue.text: Now turn holes into a deposit. Composite to equal lengths, and top-cut the freak values — because one four-hundred-gram sample invents tonnes of gold that are not there.

dialogue.speaker: zawadi
dialogue.text: Interpret the mineralised zone on every section, join the sections into a wireframe, and fill that volume with blocks.

dialogue.speaker: zawadi
dialogue.text: Each block takes its grade from nearby samples. Kriging weights them by how grade behaves here, measured as a variogram: nugget, range and sill.

dialogue.speaker: zawadi
dialogue.text: And the search is stretched along the ore trend, because continuity runs along a vein, not across it.

dialogue.speaker: zawadi
dialogue.text: Then classify honestly. Measured, Indicated, Inferred — confidence set by drill spacing, under a code such as JORC.

dialogue.speaker: zawadi
dialogue.text: That is the resource. A reserve is the part you have shown you can actually mine and sell, at a profit, with a plan. That comes next.
